mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact identities for a chosen total-rest-mass-current constitutive frame and 72 exact rational co-moving, B=0 light-cone Schur tests for the two-current principal quadratic action
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q and symbolic rational functions over Q, using exact SymPy arithmetic
mathematics.conventions: Signature -+++; c=1; species-major displacement basis; F_i0=E_i, F_ij=epsilon_ijk B_k; actual positive rest-mass weights w_a=m_a n_a/sum(m n); independent diagonal barotropic EOS; unit k

bounds.symbolic_scope: Tensor contractions through quadratic order; 2 species; direct 3x3 perpendicular determinant; rank-one inverse; algebraic threshold; single-species spectator and dust plasma controls
bounds.portal_charges: q1=q2=q retained in proof; principal matrix is independent of q; plasma control keeps distinct symbolic Q1,Q2
bounds.success_means: Declared symbolic identities reduce to zero and every declared rational Schur first principal minor and determinant are strictly positive
bounds.failure_means: An assertion failure rejects the implemented identity or matrix test pending diagnosis; timeout/output limit is inconclusive

non_claims: The finite 72-case grid is not a universal all-angle proof; PROOF.md supplies a separate analytic matrix-order reduction.
No physical derivation of the chosen mass-current frame or beta response is asserted.

No on-shell two-current halo, static law, remnant retention, conversion rate, metric constraint, finite-drift stability, B!=0 background, strong hyperbolicity at zero modes, vacuum/interface or cosmological result is computed.
No large simulation, empirical data fit, floating eigenvalue tolerance or external theorem/source authentication is used.
